**Subject: Late Check-In Request – Reservation HTN789 (April 10)**

Hi there,

I have a reservation with your hotel (Ref: HTN789) for April 10–12, 2026. My flight arrives at 11:30 AM that morning, but I may have afternoon plans in the city before heading to the hotel.

Could you confirm whether late check-in is acceptable, and if so, what time I should plan to arrive by? I want to ensure my room is held without issue.

Thanks for your assistance.

Best regards,
Alice
